steps.title: Configure Application Environment
steps.description: Set up build configuration, compile targets, and enforce pure Java/SDK architecture without external dependencies.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and System Permissions
steps.description: Declare install package permissions, external storage access, and custom file provider for package distribution.

steps.title: Define Project Schemas
steps.description: Establish local backend and administrative configuration compliance descriptors.

steps.title: Implement Native Package Content Provider
steps.description: Build custom ContentProvider to serve generated APK files securely to the Android package installer.

steps.title: Create AAB Bundle Metadata Model
steps.description: Model package parameters, manifest versions, dex files, native ABIs, and asset directory counts.

steps.title: Build Android Binary XML Processor
steps.description: Implement parser and compiler to ensure AndroidManifest.xml conforms to binary RES_XML_TYPE specifications.

steps.title: Develop APK v1 and v2 Signature Engine
steps.description: Implement pure Java RSA key generation, X.509 DER certificate creation, PKCS#7 v1 signing, and APK Signing Block v2 injection.

steps.title: Implement AAB Archive Remapping Engine
steps.description: Remap base/dex, base/res, base/manifest, base/assets, and base/lib directories into standard APK structure.

steps.title: Implement Installation Session Pipeline
steps.description: Handle unknown app installation permissions, Intent ACTION_VIEW fallback, and PackageInstaller commit sessions.

steps.title: Design Conversion Dashboard Interface
steps.description: Construct Material-themed layout featuring bundle picker, technical inspection card, progress indicator, and live logs.

steps.title: Integrate Activity Controller & Event Handlers
steps.description: Connect SAF file chooser, asynchronous bundle processing, log streaming, and installation actions.

steps.title: Building AAB Installer
steps.description: Compile sources, verify Android package parameters, and assemble the debug APK.
